aspect: Attention in the classroom is gone even when it reopens
description: After the 2014 war, UNRWA teachers reported students falling asleep in class, unable to concentrate, and performing poorly. The building being open is not the same as education happening in it.
energy_note: Present, seated, and not learning anything.

aspect: Missing transcripts follow a person for thirty years
description: A destroyed school archive means no certificate, which means no university abroad, which means a career ceiling set by an administrative event in a war the person was eight years old for.
money_note: Re-sitting exams, equivalency assessments, lost years.
energy_note: Your qualifications were in a building.
notes: Directly compounds the credential-recognition hurdles in assets/text/iran.

description: They want the original stamped transcript. The school was destroyed in 2015 and the ministry that held the duplicate was destroyed in 2016. The board notes that without documentation it cannot proceed, and closes the file.
energy_note: A file closed because a country was.

aspect: Interrupted-schooling children are placed by age, not level
description: A fourteen-year-old with four years of schooling goes into a class with fourteen-year-olds. The gap is never closed and the child correctly concludes they are stupid.
energy_note: Taught daily that you cannot do it.
